items.text: Ashton Jeanty will play after GTD and pregame workout for plantar fasciitis/ankle.
items.why: ETR final update; Rapoport 'is a go' after hopeful pregame.
items.implication: Start Jeanty as RB1/2; reverse any backup elevation.

items.text: Justin Jefferson is active vs Saints; Jordan Addison and Odell Beckham Jr. are inactive.
items.why: Schefter and Rapoport confirm Jefferson active, Addison inactive after pregame.
items.implication: Start Jefferson; sit/drop Addison this week. Jefferson volume rises without Addison.
items.opportunity: Jefferson primary target; higher snap/route share.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins will play vs Dolphins after being listed questionable.
items.why: ETR final updates and Schefter confirmation both will play.
items.implication: Start both Bengals WRs confidently in strong matchup.
items.opportunity: Full route/target share expected with both active.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. inactive for Cardinals vs Lions; trade being finalized (Texans interest).
items.why: Breaking: team informed him inactive as trade details finalized.
items.implication: Zero points; long-term team change imminent.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson and others elevated in ARI WR room.

items.text: Terry McLaurin will play/active vs Giants, though likely limited/not full go.
items.why: ETR and Schefter actives list; Garafolo/Rap note suited up but limited.
items.implication: Cautious start in rainy game; monitor snaps.
items.opportunity: Some routes but docked volume possible.

items.text: Caleb Williams officially inactive; chance to play next week.
items.opportunity: CHI pass catchers docked or scheme change.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: Expected - Zay Flowers, Carnell Tate, Rhamondre Stevenson, Alvin Kamara, Keenan Allen; multiple NOT EXPECTED and GTDs resolved later.
items.why: Comprehensive ETR injury board aligning with beat reports.
items.implication: Start these confidently; Kamara/Stevenson volume secure.
items.opportunity: Full roles for listed expected players.

items.text: Zay Flowers expected to play SNF vs Falcons despite Q foot injury.
items.implication: Start Flowers even with Huntley at QB.

items.text: Ladd McConkey not expected to play (foot); listed Q, no practice.
items.why: Schefter report; ETR summary NOT EXPECTED.
items.implication: Sit McConkey; look to LAC WR handcuffs/beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for Quentin Johnston or others.

items.text: Rico Dowdle unlikely to play vs Colts (toe); final determination in warmups.
items.implication: Sit Dowdle; PIT RB committee shifts.
items.opportunity: More work for Jaylen Warren or others.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. had only 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor; elevates Michael Wilson/Kendrick Bourne with inactive/trade.
items.why: Levitan data: MHJ non-factor pre-trade/inactive; 'Kia Kendrick Bourne szn'.
items.implication: Wilson/Bourne become viable WR3/flex in ARI offense vs DET.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Wilson without MHJ.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson as WR10 vs DET, boosted by MHJ inactive/trade.
items.why: Berry WR10; volume elevates without MHJ.

items.text: Messiest injury week remembered; still waiting on Bengals WRs early, many GTDs, docks on injured players playing; projections updated.
items.why: Quotes ETR summary; emphasizes uncertainty and projection adjustments.
items.implication: Monitor last-minute; use ETR projs for docks.
items.opportunity: Volatility creates DFS leverage and waiver bumps.

items.text: Lamar Jackson to Tyler Huntley is a downgrade but for fantasy purposes (BAL weapons) it doesn't really matter much.
items.why: Berry with Stephania Bell input; still play the skill players.
items.opportunity: Slightly less upside but volume remains.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown as RB5 vs MIA; 'Brown Gobbler' target/point machine.
items.why: Berry likes him a lot; high targets and production.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins as WR8 vs TEN; strong volume and matchup.
items.why: Berry: Love love LOVE Nico; target hog in good spot.
items.opportunity: High targets/red-zone vs weak TEN secondary.

items.text: Loves Christian Watson (WR15) vs CHI and Isaiah Likely (TE5); matchup/coverage edges.
items.why: Berry flags specific weaknesses and volume.
items.opportunity: Watson deep threats; Likely TE upside with Lamar out.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison (injury wrinkle); now confirmed inactive.
items.why: Berry fade with injury concern; aligned with inactive.
items.implication: Correct sit; no value this week.
